product.title: Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf, Lunch and Small Group City Tour

description.text: In Rio de Janeiro, this small-group 9-hour day combines the Sambadromo, Christ the Redeemer, the Tijuca Rainforest, Sugarloaf Mountain, and Maracana Stadium. Buffet lunch is included, while drinks and desserts are listed separately. Admission tickets to Christ the Redeemer, Sugarloaf, the Sambodromo, and Maracana Stadium are published on the product page, with an air-conditioned vehicle and bilingual guide. Pickup runs from hotels in Leblon, Ipanema, Copacabana, Flamengo, and Centro between 8:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m.; groups that skip hotel confirmation meet at Hotel Rio Othon Palace on Avenida Atlântica in Copacabana. The format suits visitors who want a single guided highlights day without buying four attraction tickets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Rio de Janeiro, and the itinerary stays on the Sambadromo, Corcovado, Tijuca Rainforest, and Sugarloaf Mountain that define this outing rather than a private tailor-made loop.
